question: Can knowability be a property belonging to an entity in itself?
premises: If knowability belonged to all knowers, it could not belong to only one knower.
If it belonged to only one knower, it could not belong to all knowers.
A property that shifts with the knower cannot be an intrinsic property of the entity.
inference: Knowability is not any intrinsic property of an entity.
plain_english: If something were knowable by all knowers, it would not be knowable by only one; and the reverse also fails. Therefore, knowability is not an intrinsic property of an entity at all.
